Supporting Modules.explanation: Every module writes a notification through notify(), and NotificationsGateway pushes that exact payload into the user:{id} socket room so the badge updates without refresh. The gateway authenticates the socket with JwtService at connection time, so a client cannot snoop another user's room. Users report a listing, order, delivery, or campaign. validateOwnership checks that the reporter is actually involved with the target before saving - which keeps the admin queue clean of strangers' reports. Admins are notified the moment a report is created. Shared recipe library. Only chefs and admins can authorise - enforced through volunteer specialization entries. Ingredients are composed by the recipe. Deletes are soft so recipes referenced by campaign menus still resolve. Aggregated impact metrics: rescued food weight and CO2 avoided. Both are computed via $queryRaw on the provider's completed orders rather than stored as running totals, then snapshotted per-provider so CSR reports can show month-over-month trends. Single entry point for every image in the system. ParseFilePipe composes size and type validators, and StorageService double-checks magic bytes of the buffer because client-declared MIME types cannot be trusted.

ParseFilePipe.description: NestJS pipe that composes size + type validators and applies them to every upload endpoint.

JwtAuthGuard.description: NestJS guard that enforces a valid JWT on every incoming request via JwtStrategy.

ThrottlerGuard.description: Rate-limit guard backed by @nestjs/throttler; protects /auth/* and other sensitive routes from brute force.

methods.+canActivate(ctx: ExecutionContext): boo: Allows up to N requests per minute per IP / user; throws 429 when the quota is exceeded.

MaxFileSizeValidator.description: NestJS PipeValidator; rejects uploads larger than the configured byte limit.

FileTypeValidator.description: NestJS PipeValidator; rejects uploads whose MIME type is not on the allow-list.
